description:
Remove the CLI test that re-proves dependency cycle rejection.

## Background

`crates/jit/src/graph/mod.rs` owns dependency cycle rejection, and `crates/jit/src/graph/keyed.rs:145-195` owns keyed cycle detection, including a property-based test (`:344`). Three other tests that mention cycles own different properties and stay: repository validation reporting a stored cycle (`fast_rules/validation_tests.rs:61`), batch-create atomicity (`cli_issue/batch_create_tests.rs:196`) and atomic rejection of a dependency batch (`fast_issue/bulk_operations_tests.rs:221`). `crates/jit/tests/cli_repo_workflow/integration_test.rs:616` re-proves cycle rejection through the CLI; the cycle exit code is bound by the exit-code projection suite.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `integration_test.rs` holds no dependency cycle re-proof.
- [hard] REQ-02: The cycle property it covered has an owning test in `crates/jit/src/graph/`.
title: Workflow CLI tests stop re-proving dependency cycle rejection
